name: veterinary_clinic_system_023_late_fee_assessment
instruction: Finance is assessing monthly late fees. The percentage for THIS episode is stored in veterinary_clinic_system_ops_meta.late_fee_pct (an integer percent, 3-9). For every invoice with status 'overdue' OR status 'sent' with due_date strictly before the episode date, and with unpaid balance (total_amount - amount_paid) > 0: (1) If the invoice is still 'sent', re-flag it 'overdue'. (2) Compute the late fee as round(unpaid * late_fee_pct / 100, 2) dollars, using standard half-up rounding to cents. (3) Append one line item to the invoice: {description: 'Late fee (<pct>% of overdue balance)', quantity: 1, unit_price: <fee>}. (4) Increase total_amount by the fee. (5) Increase the owner's balance by the fee, aggregated by owner. (6) Push one outbound email communications row to the owner: channel='email', direction='outbound', subject='Late fee applied <batch_code>', body='<OwnerFullName>, a <pct>% late fee of $<fee with 2 decimals> has been added to invoice <invoice_number> for <PatientName>. Please pay the new balance of $<new_total with 2 decimals>.', logged_by='system', occurred_at the episode timestamp, owner_id and patient_id set. (7) Append one audit_log row per invoice: action='LATE_FEE_APPLIED', actor='system', actor_role='system', target_collection='billing_invoices', target_id=<invoice id as string>, details='Late fee <pct>% applied to invoice <number>; fee $<fee>, new total $<new_total>', occurred_at the episode timestamp. (8) Push one ops_reports row: report='late_fee_summary', batch_code, late_fee_pct, invoice_count, total_unpaid_before (dollars), total_fees (dollars), total_new_balance (dollars), owners_affected, location_breakdown (dict keyed by location_id with {invoice_count, fee_total}). Paid and draft invoices are never touched. The solution must be idempotent.

success_criteria.summary: Read late_fee_pct from ops_meta. Target = overdue or sent-with-due<ep invoices with unpaid>0. For each: status='overdue'; line_items == original items + exact late-fee item; total_amount == seed total + fee; owner.balance == seed balance + per-owner fee sum. One outbound communication per target keyed by (subject, owner_id, body); one audit per target keyed by (action, target_collection, target_id, details); one ops_reports 'late_fee_summary' with correct aggregates. All non-target invoices and other collections byte-identical. Counts, total unpaid, total fees, and per-owner fees computed two ways (Python and SQL) and must agree.

checks.collections: all seeded collections outside the declared blast_radius

checks.expect: Target invoices re-flagged, late-fee line items appended, totals and owner balances increased, communication/audit/ops rows match, idempotent on re-run.
Target count, total unpaid, total fees, and per-owner fees agree between a raw-row Python filter and an independent SQL aggregate query.

hazards: Per-episode randomized late_fee_pct (3-9) from ops_meta: the fee amount and the late-fee line-item description both contain the pct, so a hardcoded percentage fails every reset.

Sent vs already-overdue: at seed there are no 'overdue' invoices, but the rule must handle both. The two sent past-due invoices are id 1 (INV-1001, unpaid $523) and id 2 (INV-1002, unpaid $214); a solution that only looks for status='overdue' does nothing.
Draft and paid decoys: billing_invoices id 3 (draft, due 2026-09-23) and the 257 paid invoices must remain byte-identical.

Line-item append, not replace: the existing line_items must survive unchanged and the late-fee item must be the last entry. The invoice total must increase by exactly the fee, and the owner's balance must increase by the per-owner fee sum.
Half-up cent rounding: with pct 3 on $523, the fee is $15.69; with pct 5 it is $26.15; with pct 9 it is $47.07. The verifier uses Decimal half-up rounding to cents and compares exact cents.
Idempotency: a second run must not append a second late-fee line item, double the owner balance, or duplicate communications/audit/ops rows for the same batch.

uniqueness_report.differentiation_note: Fuses a per-episode randomized percentage, nested line-item append, owner-balance fan-out, owner notification, audit trail, and summary reporting into one idempotent financial workflow. Dual-path verification on counts, unpaid, fees, and per-owner fee sums.
